prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.js and expose the function as a CommonJS export.
Required API: exports.splitEscaped = function(x), returning an array of strings or null on failure
Behavior: Split on unescaped commas. Backslash may escape only comma or backslash. Preserve empty fields. Return the failure value for another escape or a trailing backslash.
Visible example: The input a\,b,,c produces the three fields ["a,b", "", "c"].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: exports.splitEscaped=function(x){const out=[],cur=[];let e=false;for(const c of x){if(e){if(c!==','&&c!=='\\')return null;cur.push(c);e=false}else if(c==='\\')e=true;else if(c===','){out.push(cur.join(''));cur.length=0}else cur.push(c)}if(e)return null;out.push(cur.join(''));return out}
